title: Riot signs 20-year 191 MW critical IT data-center lease at Rockdale
summary: Riot executed a 20-year lease with an unnamed frontier AI lab for 191 MW of critical IT load at Rockdale. The first 96 MW is expected in December 2027 and the full 191 MW by June 2028; this is contracted future capacity, not operating capacity.

title: NVIDIA and six asset managers announce AI compute financing platform MOUs
summary: NVIDIA signed memoranda of understanding with Apollo, BlackRock, Blackstone, Brookfield, Goldman Sachs and KKR to establish independent financing platforms targeting more than $500 billion of third-party capital over time. Final agreements remain subject to execution.

title: Energy Vault announces 1.25 GW Texas AI data-center power infrastructure agreement
summary: Energy Vault announced a strategic commercial agreement for an initial 1.25 GW of integrated power infrastructure for an unnamed hyperscaler AI data center in Texas. The figure is power infrastructure, not operating critical IT capacity; initial deployments are expected over 4 to 12 months.

title: Texas governor directs comprehensive audit of ERCOT data-center interconnection queue
summary: Governor Greg Abbott directed PUCT and ERCOT to verify and audit every data center advancing through the ERCOT interconnection process before any project proceeds; noncompliant projects are to be denied grid connection. Implementation remains ongoing.

title: OpenAI and Meta commit to comply with Texas data-center audit standards
summary: The Texas governor announced that OpenAI and Meta committed to comply with the state data-center audit standards. The commitments do not themselves establish a new statute or final PUCT rule.
